name: Tranquility Cruises
summary: A glass-bottom boat based in Bridgetown that takes guests into Carlisle Bay to swim with turtles and snorkel over shipwrecks. The boat has ramps for boarding from the beach, two decks, a bar, washrooms and a waterslide, and those who prefer to stay dry can watch through the glass bottom. Trips are booked online, and the boat is also available for private charters.
standouts: Glass-bottom area for guests who prefer to stay on board
Ramps for boarding and leaving the boat on the beach
Two decks, bar, two washrooms and a waterslide
Life vests, snorkel and mask provided on board

trips.title: Turtle & Shipwreck Adventure
trips.summary: A glass-bottom boat trip in Carlisle Bay with time to swim with turtles and snorkel over a shipwreck. Guests who would rather stay dry can watch through the glass-bottom area. Cruise passengers walking from the port can meet the boat at the dock, about 20 minutes away on foot.
highlights: Swim with turtles and snorkel at a shipwreck in Carlisle Bay
Glass-bottom viewing area for guests who stay on board
Life vests, snorkel and mask on board
Waterslide, bar and two washrooms

trips.title: Private Charters
trips.summary: Tranquility, a 45 foot two-deck glass-bottom boat, can be chartered for three hours for parties, family days or a swim and snorkel with friends. Charters can stay in Carlisle Bay or head to Batts Rock. Guests may bring their own food and drinks, but no glass.
highlights: Two sailings: 10:30am to 1:30pm and 3:00pm to 6:00pm
Stay in Carlisle Bay, go to Batts Rock, or both
Bring your own food and drinks (no glass)
Main deck with washrooms, shaded seating, glass-bottom area and bar; upper deck with waterslide; sound system

trips.title: West Coast Cruise
trips.summary: A 4.5 hour cruise with two stops in Carlisle Bay, one to swim with turtles and one to snorkel at a shipwreck. The boat then cruises along the west coast with a short swim stop and returns to the dock in the Careenage around sunset. Juice is served on board.
highlights: Two Carlisle Bay stops: turtles and a shipwreck
Leisurely cruise along the west coast with a swim stop
Back in the Careenage around sunset
Juice served on board; small snacks such as sandwiches may be brought
